subject: Human Evolution
title: CRISPR and Human Evolution
description: A quick win: understand CRISPR and Human Evolution.

hook.text: For the first time, humans can edit their own genome precisely. CRISPR lets us cut, paste, and rewrite DNA.

buildup.text: Adapted from a bacterial immune system, CRISPR-Cas9 targets specific gene sequences and alters them.

discovery.text: It can potentially eliminate genetic diseases, enhance traits, or even resurrect extinct genes.

twist.text: In 2018, a scientist edited human embryos—provoking global outrage and a moratorium on heritable gene editing.

climax.text: CRISPR means human evolution is no longer only natural. We can now steer our own genetic future.

punchline.text: We evolved the ability to direct our evolution.

quiz.question: Why did the 2018 CRISPR embryo editing cause controversy?
options: It crossed the line into heritable human gene editing without consent
